toolContract.requiredExecutionIdentity: host-delivered factory context agentId + sessionKey + sessionId and execute(host-delivered toolCallId, params, signal, onUpdate)
toolContract.runIdUse: not present in the plugin tool factory context and therefore not part of the MasuGate request identity
toolContract.masugateIdempotencyNamespace: openclaw:v2:sha256(canonical JSON tuple [openclaw,2,agentId,sessionKey,sessionId,toolCallId]); same-id duplicate delivery only, not provider-retry identity
toolContract.mcpDependency: none for the flagship plugin path

approval.backgroundNativeApprovalRpc: unavailable to installed plugins: runtime.gateway.request is operator.write scoped while plugin.approval.* requires operator.approvals
approval.resolutionCallbackOrdering: OpenClaw fire-and-forgets onResolution; a returned allow is not proof that an async callback completed
approval.restartBehavior: discard the orphaned native presentation and reconcile the MasuGate pending id; the 2.0 test helper proves queued next-turn reminder behavior only, while production reminder/requeue wiring, the authoritative resume tool, and resolution handoff are Step 2.4 work
approval.resultDeliveryAfterRestart: the 2.0 oracle proves durable reminder delivery only; Step 2.4 must validate the pending locator and re-enter MasuGate before any effect; never replay the external effect

sandbox.reference_containment_enforcement: Step 2.3 publishes and adversarially tests the complete-mediation profile

maintenance.upgradeRule: No tag, image, Node, or SDK bump without updating this manifest and passing the full compatibility harness.
maintenance.securityUpdates: Repin promptly, rerun the oracle, and review identity, result, approval, restart, and sandbox deltas before merge.
